ledger: Man in striped shirt | stands facing camera in front of back wooden door | turns left and knocks on left wooden door at 00:08-00:09 | moves leftward, uncovering the door panel previously behind his head

Back wooden door with hanging blue coat | has a round brass medallion above the coat and a plain recessed wooden panel immediately to the right of the coat behind the man's head | round brass medallion disappears, a framed picture appears inside the recessed panel immediately right of the coat, and a bright glass window pane appears to its right | layout changes during camera pan at 00:07-00:09

Right green wall strip and adjacent picture door | located immediately to the right of the back wooden door's frame with a mounted wooden switch box | replaced by the newly materialized framed picture and glass window pane next to the blue coat | disappears during leftward pan

Left wooden door and wall | angled wooden door partially visible on the far left edge | fully revealed on the left with a brass doorknob and adjacent green wall with switches/boxes | revealed as camera pans left at 00:08-00:09

findings.entity: back wooden door and right wall layout
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, the panel immediately to the right of the hanging blue coat (behind the man's head) is a plain recessed wooden door panel, followed to the right by the door casing, a narrow green wall strip with a wooden switch box, and a separate door holding a framed picture. When the man turns left and the camera pans left at 00:08-00:09, the layout directly to the right of the blue coat changes: the plain panel behind where his head was now contains a framed picture right next to the coat, the round brass ornament above the coat vanishes, and a glass window pane appears where the doorframe and green wall strip were located.
